_comment_purpose: Source of truth for the set of ci:* gates that must be exercised at acceptance time. Consumed by tools/check_acceptance_completeness.mjs (wired as ci:acceptance-completeness in package.json). Every ci:* script MUST appear here so acceptance cannot silently omit a gate.
_comment_policy: Every ci:* script in package.json MUST appear in either accepted[] or exempt[]. accepted[] = gates run as part of acceptance / local CI. exempt[] = gates that cannot run from a worktree-local npm run (e.g. require GITHUB_EVENT_PATH or PR body); each exemption MUST carry a justification. The article-engine rewrite (2026-07) retired the fragment-era narrative/samples/hook density gates along with their tools; their entries were removed here to keep the manifest in sync with package.json.

exempt.name: ci:release-checklist
exempt.reason: Requires --body <path> or GITHUB_EVENT_PATH. Exercised by GitHub Actions at PR-creation time only; cannot run from a worktree-local npm run invocation. Documented in artifacts/phase13-agent-a5/audit-2026-05-06-phase13.md §C5.
